title: FD002 core literature comparability v1
conclusion: No directly protocol-equivalent published comparator was identified in the manuscript-grade core literature set.

category_definitions.A: FD002 anomaly/degradation detection with engine-disjoint or equivalent held-out evaluation, unsupervised/one-class/healthy-only training, compatible onset and metric, and clearly reported held-out results.
category_definitions.B: Partial alignment with material mismatch in labels, split, alert semantics, supervision, or metrics.
category_definitions.C: Contextual C-MAPSS, RUL, other-subset, or incompatible-condition benchmark.
category_definitions.D: Foundational or methodological evidence without directly comparable FD002 evaluation.

project_results.boundary: Internal held-out proxy-labelled results; not official NASA-test, observed physical-onset, or operational field performance.
